article_title: Spotted wildcat from Bolivian forest revealed as new species

tasks.prompt: What is the main significance of the DNA study?
options: It revealed previously unrecognised tiger cat species
It showed all tiger cats are domestic cats
It proved tiger cats live only in Bolivia
It found that large cats need no conservation
tasks.correct_answer: It revealed previously unrecognised tiger cat species
tasks.explanation_hebrew: מחקר הדנ״א חשף מינים נוספים של חתולי טיגר, ובהם המין מבוליביה.

tasks.prompt: What first led Dr Nogales-Ascarrunz to investigate Tigrino?
options: A museum displayed its skeleton
She noticed its unusual appearance while volunteering at a sanctuary
It was photographed on an island
A farmer identified it as a tiger
tasks.correct_answer: She noticed its unusual appearance while volunteering at a sanctuary
tasks.explanation_hebrew: החוקרת הבחינה במראהו החריג בזמן שהתנדבה במקלט.

tasks.prompt: What does “went under the radar” mean in the account of the cat?
options: It avoided aircraft
It migrated secretly
It remained unnoticed as a distinct species
It was tracked electronically
tasks.correct_answer: It remained unnoticed as a distinct species
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי מתאר מין שלא זוהה כנפרד משום שדמה לחתולי בר אחרים.

tasks.prompt: What does “elusive” suggest about these mammals?
options: They are unusually aggressive
They are easy to breed
They are found only in museums
They are difficult to find or observe
tasks.correct_answer: They are difficult to find or observe
tasks.explanation_hebrew: elusive מתאר בעלי חיים שקשה למצוא או לצפות בהם.

tasks.prompt: How did researchers investigate tiger cats' family history?
options: They compared DNA from living animals and museum specimens
They measured only domestic kittens
They interviewed tourists without collecting biological evidence
They compared lions' hunting behaviour
tasks.correct_answer: They compared DNA from living animals and museum specimens
tasks.explanation_hebrew: החוקרים השתמשו בדנ״א מבעלי חיים חיים ומדגימות במוזיאונים.

tasks.prompt: Why are tiger cats called a “taxonomic nightmare”?
options: They cannot survive outside museums
Their similar appearance and scarce specimens make classification difficult
They are all named after tigers
They have no genetic differences
tasks.correct_answer: Their similar appearance and scarce specimens make classification difficult
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הדמיון החיצוני ומיעוט הדגימות מקשים על המיון למינים.

tasks.prompt: Why does one confirmed living member not prove that Tigrino is the only surviving member?
expected_points: Only one animal has been confirmed
Other reported sightings have not been investigated
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להבחין בין מספר הפרטים שאומתו לבין כלל האוכלוסייה.

tasks.prompt: Name three threats to tiger cats identified in the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין את שלושת האיומים המפורשים בכתבה.

tasks.prompt: Summarise how Tigrino led to a new species discovery and why this matters for conservation.
expected_points: An unusual sanctuary cat prompted investigation
The study suggests five rather than three tiger cat species
Knowing identity and distribution is necessary for protection
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לסכם באנגלית את תהליך הגילוי ואת הקשר לשימור, ללא קביעה שנותר רק פרט אחד.

tasks.prompt: Explain to a friend why appearance alone was not enough to classify Tigrino. Use two details from the report.
expected_points: Tiger cats have similar spots and stripes
Even experts struggle to distinguish them
DNA provides evidence of separate species
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב הסבר באנגלית המבוסס על לפחות שני פרטים מהכתבה.
